prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original wide scenic establishing illustration of the northern lands of Eriador where the Rangers of the North keep watch and dwell, for a One Ring culture background. Match the user's approved latest light-ivory pencil establishing series: Lindon, Rivendell, the Shire and Dale. Camera pulled far back and elevated to a high three-quarter viewpoint across a broad lonely landscape of rolling moorland hills, heather-covered ridges, scattered weathered rocks, patches of old woodland and distant hazy uplands. The remains of an ancient northern kingdom are woven through the terrain: a broken stone watchtower on a middle-ground hill, a ruined gate and a few tumbled arches, moss-covered foundation walls, fragments of an old paved road crossing the hills, and a small ruined stone bridge over a winding stream. Arrange these as believable sparse remnants across a spacious landscape, not a dense city or a collection of towering fantasy ruins. In a sheltered wooded hollow beneath a rocky slope, show a very modest discreet ranger refuge: two or three low weathered stone-and-timber shelters partly hidden by trees beside the remnants of an old wall, a covered fire pit and a small wood store, subtle rather than a fortified settlement. The land should feel inhabited only by a few watchful wanderers, quiet, resilient, weather-beaten and steeped in memory. Foreground low grasses, heather, a fallen carved stone and a lightly sketched winding trail lead toward the ruins; layered hills fade into a large pale overcast sky. No foreground people, no portraits, no conspicuous figures, no battle, monsters or grand occupied castles: the hills, wilderness and abandoned ancient stonework are the subject. STYLE: delicate traditional graphite and extremely muted brown-gray pencil drawing on very light near-white warm ivory drawing paper, subtle grain, expressive fine contours, restrained parallel hatching and crosshatching, airy shading with generous untouched pale paper. Selectively describe nearby rocks, grasses and ruins; progressively lighten and simplify the distant hills and woods. Suggest cool mist and muted daylight using pale paper and fine pencil contrasts, no overall dark shading. Same pale paper tone as the approved series, no orange, peach, yellow or tan wash. No colored paint, thick oil brushwork, watercolor wash, heavy black ink fills, photorealism, glossy digital rendering or 3D. Wide 16:9 full-bleed landscape, intended final export 2560x1440. No writing, readable runes, labels, letters, captions, map symbols, decorative border, blank bottom strip, black bars, watermark or UI.
